statement: For every r>=1, a specified regular source of dimension N=r+2 has zero CH^r and a principal regular puncture with non-torsion ordinary J^r; combined ordinary J2 surjectivity is universal exactly when N<=3 over C
depends_on: C.3e strict-local cone injection; C.3s generic-point non-support; Skalit2017 Corollary6.4(i); C.3r/C.3ae/C.3ag for the full J2 dimension corollary
notes: R is the strict henselization of the regular affine (r+2)-space local ring; f is the Fermat form of degree r+2. The target class is the specified geometric generic point minus a specified algebraic point on the Calabi-Yau base. Actual fixed-product curve families prove ordinary algebraic triviality. No claim that all higher-r dimensions are settled.
